provenance: New English translation from source rows E2720-E2799; adjacent rows E2700-E2719 reviewed.
context: Tavern quest conversations: a bounty, Tanya's reluctant attendance at a revenge duel, and Fiore's delivery and discussion of the seal.
decisions: Sentences continuing over row boundaries retain the matching break. Unknown duel participants use neutral references. Strage and Graham follow the glossary.

translations.en: they might get some sort of reward in the demon realm.
Whatever the reason, it proves they can no longer
afford to ignore you.
Yeah. They can appear out of the shadows without warning,
so they'll get you if you aren't really careful.
I'm sorry.
I took you somewhere so dangerous,
and now there's a bounty on you. I'm really sorry.
Please take this item as an apology, too.
As your reward, @7rTanya@0r gave you @3r8,800 G@0r and
It isn't @7rTanya's@0r fault they're after your life.
Think of it as the price of fame.
@7rTanya@0r gave you @3r3,000 G@0r as your reward.
I don't really feel like going,
but it's about time I went.
Let's hurry over there and come straight back.
I'm still trying to decide.
To go or not to go, that's the question.
I mean, @7rTanya@0r would feel awfully lonely going alone...
Certainly, no one would want to attend a revenge duel alone.
What should you do? Perhaps you ought to go along.
It's such a relief to hear you'll come with me.
Obviously, they can't have a duel right here in town,
so they're meeting just inside @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r
to settle their grudge.
It really is right by the entrance,
so I'm sorry to take up your time, but...
Oh, you can't...
I suppose so. They asked me to help,
so maybe it's a promise I ought to keep on my own?
With that, @7rTanya@0r lowered her head.
Um, there's something I'd like to ask you.
Someone I know asked me to help them get revenge.
But I really don't want to go.
Still, I'd feel bad letting them down,
so I have to... Ugh, I just can't get excited about it.
That's why I'd like you to come with me.
I'll be the only one helping with the revenge,
so could you just come along as a witness or something?
You never imagined that people would be
settling blood feuds here in this town.
@7rTanya@0r seems genuinely troubled,
and clearly dreads going to the meeting place alone.
You received @3rDrake Boots@0r.
All right! Great work!
Here's your reward for the job!
As your reward, @7rFiore@0r gave you @3r6,600 G@0r and
By the way, why are they
so desperate to break the seal?
Honestly... Isn't it obvious if you think for a moment?
I'm a thief. Thinking is a mage's job.
Enlighten me, clever one! In simple terms, please.
Good grief...
All right? Listen carefully.
You could build an elaborate magic circle to reach the next room,
or simply open the door and walk in without any effort...
Which would you choose?
Ohh, I get it. You'd use the door.
Normally, yes, unless the other way offers some extra benefit.
In other words, if the seal holding that door shut is broken,
all those enormous monsters that haven't come because
passing through the seal is too much trouble might flood in.
Perhaps that danger is why @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
sealed the door so tightly, even at the cost of his life.
I see...
Let's all do our best to keep the seal from breaking.
This concerns more than our town. It's for the whole world.
@7rFiore@0r gave you @3r10,000 G@0r as your reward.
All right, let's get moving.
If we're late, the people waiting could be in danger.
Let's get this delivery moving!
What? Did you come to tease me again?
I'm seriously trying to work out what to do
because you won't take the job!
Take some responsibility and accept it already!
It's not some weird delivery, you know!
I'm so glad you're someone I can reason with!
We're going to the upper levels of @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r.
The adventurer we're delivering to went to set up an observation circle.
It's a magic circle for finding out what the monsters are planning.
